issues: B's color settle was scheduled at t≈1.08, so 'changed' was still purple at the end and the final state never appeared
The aurora read as one pale purple haze; the orange core was buried under the main layer and nothing moved inside it
Copy was a neutral placeholder ('For many years' / 'everything changed') in one centered line with no hierarchy or sign-off, so the turn carried no weight
After the flip only a dimmed glow remained: the frame simply 'went dark' rather than arriving at a new scene
changes: The light palette is rebuilt as a real aurora (custom): teal-green, cool cyan and violet soft blooms rise from a misty #e9edf0 ground, drifting at different rates, using soft radial gradients instead of full-frame blur
The flip stays the key beat and tightens to 11f (≈0.37s) into a blue-tinted polar night #05080e; the blooms compress to a 0.4 afterglow with a 6% overshoot squash
Once the dark lands, the night develops: 18 swaying, flickering aurora curtains with bright cores plus 80 twinkling stars, so the flip reads as 'night fell and the aurora came out'

Copy becomes a real turn: A 'For years, forecasts were guesses.' at 92px blurs in and out by word; B 'See it coming.' at 140px blurs in by word, settles from aurora green to white, then a tracked brand line resolves
Duration 156 to 172f; B and the lockup finish before f156, leaving a clean 16f hold with curtains still drifting
